task: Global Innovator Awards 2026 at The Dorchester London on 16 November 2026: who organises it, partners, press coverage, and what does it say about NEXUS Creative HQ? Also list any press coverage of NEXUS Creative HQ, S-Tron Shanghai participation, City of London Corporation partnership, RidgeCore Ventures and Tianjin MOU.

result.json_content: {"result":"The Global Innovator Awards 2026 are scheduled for 16 November 2026 at The Dorchester in London. NEXUS created the programme; it is also described as powered by NEXUS. The Global Entrepreneur Programme (GEP) endorses it, and FounderX identifies itself as a Community Partner. Coverage and announcements in the passages include NEXUS’s own awards announcement, Michelle Hua’s awards post, and FounderX’s awards page. They describe NEXUS as a UK innovation hub connecting frontier-technology companies and ecosystems, helping founders establish, grow and scale in the UK, and as the creator of awards recognising international founders’ contributions here. For S-Tron Shanghai, the passages include a NEXUS announcement about a partnership and a 2025 item saying NEXUS would represent the UK at S-Tron Shanghai. They do not establish NEXUS’s participation in the 2026 event. The passages provide no supported press-coverage details about a City of London Corporation partnership, RidgeCore Ventures, or a Tianjin MOU."}
